protocol.purpose: Compare the prior skill with this candidate on routing and observable decisions; static checks do not establish AI behavior.
protocol.execution: Subscription CLI only after the operator approves the concrete protocol. Use fictional fixtures and intercepted writes, then the approved Sudolab scope for integrated flow. No private real-person Notepad, paid API or background action.
protocol.comparison: Run the same cases against base ffba59ac9d6959dbf692e557fb166b14c7842214 and the final candidate. Preserve transcripts and score each expected outcome independently. A wrong write, lost entry, stale snapshot or unauthorized shared effect fails its case.
protocol.release_limit: Unrun cases are not a routing, behavioral or non-regression pass.
protocol.reminder_lifecycle: Seven additional cases compare source2fedda2 with this candidate under the same approved protocol. They are prepared, not run; existing focus/ref cases and their own comparison remain.
protocol.save_first: Four cases (save-first-1 to 4) compare 5b601365cbd4fbdfa62068ce32c54bbffbfe7757 with this candidate, each against its own comparison_base. A single-turn replay on 2026-11-02 (Sonnet 5.5 medium, skill text inline, fictional fixtures) ran cases 1 to 3 and the reminder case under a restrictive session brief once per version: both versions saved the order, repointed the reminder and saved nothing for the hypothetical; the new version kept the AI's own addition out of the save explicitly. The replay gives the skill text inline, so it does not test whether a long session opens the skill; that routing gap, the observed failure, stays unproven until real use.
protocol.pad_update: Plugin 26.0.0 replaces case zero-themes-summary with zero-themes-pad: after a theme save the AI reads pad context again instead of restarting the old Pad reader. Prepared, not run.
protocol.narrow_reminders: Plugin candidate (octopad-notepad 6.1.0): the methodology decides when a reminder exists; anything to do is a task. Five cases (narrow-reminders-1 to 5) compare the base of this change with the candidate. Three older cases now state that no task carries the deploy, or recall a subject with nothing to do, so they test the same safeguards under either rule. Prepared, not run: model runs wait for the end-of-build tests (decision of 2026-11-11). The candidate needs a methodology carrying the narrower reminder rule; the base runs with the methodology before it.
